title: Prove exact unequal-width query capacity for the shared-path theta mask
body:
For the seven-vertex theta mask with paths `u-a-v`, `u-b-c-v`, and `u-d-e-v`, arbitrary directed rectangular fitting blocks have exact minimum rank `sum(d) − nu_b(d)` over every field and every nonnegative payload-width vector. Integral edge/private coordinate sharing attains it, so block mixing cannot improve the query dimension on this first overlapping-cycle case from PR #5023's open question.

The proof establishes a shared-path half-total inequality, applies it to arbitrary scalar-coordinate principal restrictions, and uses the explicitly cited classical Tutte–Berge theorem to obtain the whole matching lower bound. The attaining constructor uses a finite residual-capacity dynamic program; its pseudopolynomial state count is stated explicitly. No physical supplier, new kappa, or selected-frontier change is claimed. Preparation, copies, frames, dirty restoration, precision, tapes and outer admission remain outside scope.

Credit JoyboyBrian #5023, Tekalign #3362, Nick Petalas #4909, Sagar Thakrar #2484, the retained query-mask lineage, and Tutte/Berge's matching theorem. PR #5180 classifies single-cycle minimizers; this result concerns a different mask with a shared path. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Separate AI proof review found no blocker, without claiming human or formal proof-kernel acceptance.

Validation on CPython 3.12.2:

- Registered normal/optimized checks: 180 width vectors; 540 mixed full operators; 540 arbitrary coordinate restrictions; 45 arbitrary rectangular-block operators; all 65,536 directed binary scalar completions; four complete matching-deficiency duals; ten rejecting controls.
- Exact source history and committed-byte checks pass for all eleven declared files. Official export integrity passes.
- Fresh read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay passes. Missing RESULT/SOURCES, Boolean-list receipt substitution, source-byte corruption, missing matched successors and erased paired off-diagonal entries all reject. Export bytes are restored exactly.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/theta-query-capacity`. Universal scope rests on the written proof and cited matching theorem, not the finite checks. Hosted CI is pending publication.
